instruct: A young woman with a soft, deep-for-her-age voice and slow, deliberate delivery — an almost hypnotic bedtime-story cadence, warm and steady, with tenderness in the low notes and a faint wistfulness underneath. Very intimate, close to the microphone, quiet strength, no brightness, no breathiness.

text: Read it to me once — just once. Then close your eyes, and I'll show you what your story sounds like when the canyon gives it back.
